info: PROPOSED description-only overlay for docs/openapi-v1.json. It records product decisions that the generated spec does not yet state. It changes no routes, fields or types and has NOT been applied to the backend; the backend owner must add the same text to the FastAPI models/params (the spec is generated by apps/api/export_openapi.py). Applying it is a docs-only change.

actions.description: USER id (users.id) of the reported person. NOT a companion profile id. The reporter is always the authenticated user (derived from the access token); a client-supplied reporter id is rejected with 422 extra_forbidden. Unknown id → 404 reported_user_not_found; own id → 422 invalid_report.
Optional booking the report refers to. The caller must be a participant and reported_user_id must be the other participant, otherwise 422 invalid_report_target.

Companion PROFILE id (not a user id). Public responses do not expose the owning user id; a documented profile→user mapping does not exist yet, so reports/blocks against a companion cannot be filed by customers.
USER id of the customer. A companion may use it as reported_user_id / block target.
Companion PROFILE id (not a user id).
Integer amount in tiyin (minor unit of `currency`; for UZS 100 tiyin = 1 UZS). Computed by the server as service price_minor × (duration_minutes / unit_minutes).
Price per `unit_minutes`, integer tiyin (UZS: 100 tiyin = 1 UZS), >= 0. Must fit a signed 64-bit integer; clients that use IEEE-754 numbers can only represent values up to 2^53-1 exactly.
Price per `unit_minutes`, integer tiyin (UZS: 100 tiyin = 1 UZS).
Booking amount in integer tiyin (currency: `currency`).

Platform fee in integer tiyin, calculated ONLY by the backend from YONDO_PLATFORM_FEE_BPS (round half up on integer arithmetic). Clients must display it, never compute it. If the fee policy is not configured the payment request fails with 503 payment_configuration_unavailable. Delivery fees are a separate concept and are never included here.
subtotal_minor + platform_fee_minor, integer tiyin, charged amount.
Flag only: set when a paid booking is cancelled. No cancellation percentage or refundable amount is defined, and no refund is calculated or executed by this flag.
Integer tiyin (UZS: 100 tiyin = 1 UZS), >= 0.
Integer tiyin (UZS: 100 tiyin = 1 UZS).
Stable internal identifier. The value `romantic` is displayed to users as “Maxsus kunlar”; the identifier is unchanged (no migration).
Stable internal identifier. The value `romantic` is displayed to users as “Maxsus kunlar”.
Delivery fee in integer tiyin, kept separate from the platform fee. null = delivery pricing policy not configured (never guessed by clients).
Server-calculated payable total in integer tiyin; null until fee/delivery policy is configured. Test orders never move real money (real_money_moved=false).

Start of the requested interval, ISO-8601 instant WITH offset or Z (naive timestamps are rejected). Must be sent together with available_until, and available_until must be after it, else 422 invalid_discovery_filter. A companion matches only on FULL CONTAINMENT: availability.starts_at <= available_from AND availability.ends_at >= available_until. Profiles with a pending/accepted/confirmed/active booking overlapping the interval are excluded (half-open overlap; touching boundaries do not conflict).
End of the requested interval (exclusive), ISO-8601 instant with offset or Z. Must be after available_from. See available_from for the containment rule.
